visualCharacteristics.purpose: Contact strip on a person profile page: office address and LinkedIn link

contentPattern.structure: One row per contact item (or one cell holding a bulleted list): office address linked to the office page, LinkedIn (or other social) URL, optional tel: phone and mailto: email links. Items are typed by link (linkedin/twitter/facebook/instagram/phone/email, otherwise address); bare social URLs become icon links with an aria-label

usage: Person profile pages (/personnel/*), directly below the profile intro.
reuseGuidance: Use for short contact/address + social strips tied to a person. For full office details with a map use office-info.
